legacy_gate_rejected.proposed: falsify if |<Psi_goal, Psi_Y>| < 0.20 vs demonstration outputs
reasons: Psi_goal built from the same demonstration outputs it is compared against (self-referential, no held-out test)
raw inner product is scale-dependent and uncalibrated

hypothesis: per-block orthogonal Procrustes recovers an underlying orthogonal mapping from demonstration pairs with held-out generalization

fixture.split: episode/task-disjoint by demo index (calibration first 10, held-out last 4)
fixture.known_transform: per-block orthogonal O_k from QR of Gaussian; Y_known = X @ O_k, per-block unit rows
fixture.shuffle: derangement pi(i) = (i+1) mod 10 (no fixed points) on calibration X side

controls.C1: known-transform positive: fit on (X, Y_known), reconstruct held-out
controls.C2: held-out reconstruction: fit on calibration only, reconstruct held-out
controls.C3: shuffled-pair negative: fit on deranged pairs, reconstruct held-out

diagnostics: per-block SVD condition number of M_k (median, p95)
scope: validation of the EXISTING henri_goal_adapter.py path only; no reimplementation, no production enablement, no benchmark score
